_comment: Map-file stems / /maps:<x> skills intentionally exempt from maps-coverage. key = map-file stem OR skill basename; value = reason. Manual registries + inventory snapshots are not /maps:<x> generator outputs. Enforced by scripts/checks/maps-coverage.js. Keep SMALL — prefer registering a map in /maps:all over excluding it.

exclusions.INVENTORY: Manual top-level inventory doc — not a /maps:<x> generator output.
exclusions.SPEC_GRAPH: Manual spec-dependency graph (paths.specGraph); hand-maintained, not a maps generator.
exclusions.systems-inventory: Systems manifest render/snapshot (via /maps:systems + /discover:systems), not a standalone /maps:systems-inventory skill.
exclusions.inventory-architecture: Inventory snapshot — intermediate data produced by the maps/discover generators, not a standalone persisted map.
exclusions.guide-integration: Recording store written by /guides:integrate (one record per guide×anchor placement); enforced by /guides:coverage, not a /maps:<x> generator output.
